canonical_title: Protection of equipment in wheel wells

versions.title_at_revision: Protection of equipment in wheel wells
versions.text:
Standard: The effects of a bursting tire, flailing tire tread, and wheel brake temperatures do not degrade or cause loss of SCFs provided by components and structure located on the landing gear and in the wheel wells. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct an analysis to verify safety-critical components, structure, or shielding can withstand force of tire failures to prevent loss of a SCF.
(2) Conduct thermal analysis to verify safety-critical components and structure can withstand brake temperatures with gear retracted from undetected break failures (e.g., dragging brake) or protected with heat shields.
